name: Adrenaline Syringe
text: Gain +2 Movement this turn.

name: First Aid Kit
text: Restore 1 Health.

name: Soothing Tonic
text: Restore 1 Sanity.

name: Lantern
text: Reveal all face-down Encounter Cards in your current room.

name: Map Fragment
text: You may immediately draw and place a new room from the deck.

name: Heavy Wrench
text: Deal 2 damage to a Monster in an adjacent space.

name: Old Revolver
text: Deal 1 damage to a Monster up to 2 spaces away.

name: Whispering Stone
text: Ignore the effects of one Event Card.

name: Binding Chalk
text: Prevent a Monster in an adjacent space from engaging you this turn.

name: Ritual Knife
text: Sacrifice 1 Health to deal 2 damage.

name: Protective Amulet
text: Ignore the next source of Sanity loss.

name: Holy Water
text: Instantly banish a Monster in an adjacent space (does not work on Boss).

name: Antique Key
text: Open a locked door or gain access to a sealed room.

name: Lucky Charm
text: Reroll any die you just rolled.

name: Clue Journal
text: Gain 1 Clue Token.

name: Signal Flare
text: Move another player up to 2 spaces toward you.

name: Tattered Grimoire
text: Gain 1 Sanity but lose 1 Health.

name: Painkillers
text: Ignore all damage from a single source (except the Boss).

name: Ghost Bell
text: All Monsters in adjacent rooms are pushed 1 space away.

name: Mirror Shard
text: Look at the top 3 Encounter Cards and reorder them.

name: Seal Fragment
text: Gain 1 Shift Point.

name: Dark Dice
text: Roll 1d6. On 4-6, gain 1 Clue. On 1-3, lose 1 Sanity.

name: Dusty Pocketwatch
text: Take an immediate extra action.

name: Discarded Note
text: Choose another player. They gain 1 Clue Token.
